notes: COUNTER DECISION: option (ii), settledAttempts, NOT the raw `iteration` loop variable. The two disagree on exactly one row — a generator-failure round advances `iteration` but produces no evaluations entry on the PGE side (gate_syntax routes to the corrector 'without spending an evaluation'), so version:iteration would make the engines disagree on precisely the round shape sc-6-1 exists to unify. settledAttempts counts rounds that reached a decisive verdict (pass, fail, AND security-blocked — the evaluator runs before the security check imperatively), matching how PGE's attempts counts non-skipped evaluations entries, but NOT a round where the generator itself failed and the evaluator never ran. Pinned by a dedicated discriminating test (generator-failure-then-pass writes version:1, not 2) and verified against a live mutation. The out-of-loop return deliberately stays version-less even though settledAttempts is in scope there — an unsettled contract has no attempt count to report.
